label: prf:binding-closure-conditional
title: Proof of binding closure conditional on the per-term mass identity
html:
By input (C), stated as a conjecture and assumed here, the binding is the body-order series, B(K)=\sum_{n}\,(\text{\(n\)-body term}). By the conditional input (B), each body term factors as B_n = m_e\,a_D^{(n)}. Substituting and pulling the common scale m_e out of the (finite) sum,

B(K) \;=\; \sum_n B_n \;=\; \sum_n m_e\,a_D^{(n)} \;=\; m_e\sum_n a_D^{(n)} .

Rewriting each period through the residue form (The Seiberg–Witten period is an algebraic residue sum) gives the second displayed equality of the statement; the growth law of the a_D^{(n)} is the solution of the q-difference recurrence (The binding generating function's q-difference equation gives a depth-d recurrence). Given (C) and (B), the closed form of Binding closure, conditional on the per-term mass identity follows by distributing the factor over the finite sum and comparing the sums termwise; the result is conditional exactly on inputs (C) and (B). \qquad\blacksquare
heading: Proof
